code: For each edge (u -> v) with onset/terminus:   depart = max(arrival[u], onset)   if depart < terminus AND depart < arrival[v]:     arrival[v] = depart Repeat until no changes (handles non-DAG cycles).

title: Temporal Network Analysis Module — Build Spec

title: Temporal Network Analysis Module — Build Spec
text: loops – use vapply, tapply, tabulate, vectorized ops. Exception: temporal BFS inner loop (unavoidable sequential dependency). igraph Suggests – core metrics (degree, reachability, burstiness, formation/dissolution, temporal density) must work without igraph. Snapshot-based metrics gracefully skip igraph unavailable. Base R preferred – tidyverse. ggplot2 plots (already Import). cograph_network compatible – $nodes, $edges, $directed, $meta fields follow cograph conventions. temporal_network class can passed cograph functions inspect fields. NEVER touch diagonals – zeroing, excluding, modifying diagonal entries matrix operation. CRAN-ready – @return tags exports, global variable warnings, _R_CHECK_LIMIT_CORES_ guard parallel code.

title: Tidy Temporal Network Analysis
text: Dynet R package provides functions constructing, measuring visualising temporal networks, , networks whose ties located time. network built one constructor four kinds relational log: interval logs start end per tie, contact logs instantaneous events, threaded logs forum chat data, co-presence logs actors sharing group become connected. Measurement covers time-varying centrality, graph-level structure, tie formation dissolution, tie duration, burstiness, group mixing, time-respecting paths, reachability temporal centrality. Every function returns data frame one row per observation, addressed vertex name, results read, plotted modelled without manipulation. implementation base R; values checked igraph, sna tsna packages test suite. Drawing delegated cograph, every Dynet network instance.

Attributes record event identity, dispersion, memory, loop, weight, session-gap conventions event_identity = "incident_spell_start", dispersion = "population", memory = "lag1_pearson", loop_contribution = "one_event", weights = "ignored", mode-specific session_gaps.

title: Burstiness and memory of each vertex's activity — burstiness
text: One raw spell row contributes start time distinct incident vertex. self-loop one event, equal-time rows remain distinct events, direction alter incidence, interval ends weights ignored. Sorted equal times therefore create legitimate zero gaps. Explicitly onset-censored limits observed onset events excluded; terminus censoring affect onset sequence. usable interevent gaps \(\tau_1,\ldots,\tau_k\), burstiness $$B=(\sigma-\mu)/(\sigma+\mu),$$ \(\mu\) mean \(\sigma=\sqrt{k^{-1}\sum_i(\tau_i-\mu)^2}\) population standard deviation equal-mass empirical gap distribution. mean_gap needs least one gap. Burstiness needs least two NA every usable gap zero. finite-sample range [-1, 1). Memory ordinary Pearson correlation consecutive gaps. needs least two adjacent-gap pairs nonzero variation sides; otherwise NA. sessions = "bounded", primitive gaps adjacent pairs formed within session pooled, cross-session gap introduced. Collapse includes calendar gaps erasing labels; separate returns session-local blocks fixed vertex universe.

Directed source edges produce one within-slice arc. undirected nonloop edge produces reciprocal arcs, undirected loop emitted .
